name: Navarredonda de Gredos (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navarredonda de Gredos (a red goat's head on white above a river, within a compony bordure).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 19 May 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 146 of 30 July 1999); the flag is described as a square flag of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Navarredonda de Gredos arms — goat's head above a river, compony bordure
